title: TNM Cancer Staging
definition: Staging describes Tumor size, Node involvement, and Metastasis — T2N1M0, for example. Stage determines treatment and prognosis more than any other factor. Every cancer plan starts with an accurate stage.

Treatment runs in cycles: infusion days, rest weeks, re-scans. Inpatient stays handle complications like neutropenic fever. Survivorship clinics follow patients for years after treatment ends.

    return f"BSA {bsa:.2f} m2 -> dose {round(bsa*mg_per_m2,1)} mg"
